summary: Backend 12/12 pass after fix. Frontend: registration/login/HUD work, but R3F 3D scene crashes with TypeError 'Cannot convert undefined or null to object' and 'Cannot set x-line-number' - webpack dev overlay blocks all interactions.

ui_bugs.issue: Uncaught runtime errors: R3F: Cannot set 'x-line-number'. Ensure it is an object before setting 'line-number'; TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object (removeChild). Causes webpack-dev-server-client-overlay iframe to block all clicks (pause, form-word buttons unclickable).

action_items: Fix R3F runtime errors in Game.js / 3D components (RobotCharacter, FloatingIsland, FloatingLetter). Likely cause: a babel/SWC plugin injecting JSX source attributes (x-line-number, x-file-name etc.) on <mesh>/<group> elements - R3F's applyProps cannot handle these as Three.js properties. Remove/disable the JSX source-injection plugin (e.g. babel-plugin-add-jsx-attributes or similar from CRACO/CRA config) or filter unknown props before passing to R3F primitives.

Update CORS in backend/.env FRONTEND_URL to actual preview URL or set CORS_ORIGINS - currently FRONTEND_URL=http://localhost:3000 but app served from block-island-1.preview.emergentagent.com (works because same-origin via ingress, but brittle).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_current_user previously returned _id but downstream used user['id'] - fixed by T1
Cookies set with secure=false samesite=lax; for cross-site production deploys would need secure=true samesite=none
No rate limiting / brute force lockout (auth_testing.md requirement)
seed_admin is idempotent and updates password if changed - good
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully working. Frontend landing/register/login/HUD render OK and reach /game. The 3D scene throws R3F runtime errors that pop up a webpack dev overlay blocking all UI clicks. Root cause likely JSX-source attribute injection (x-line-number, x-file-name, x-id, x-component) being passed as R3F props. Fix the babel plugin / CRA config or filter props in 3D components.
rca of the issue: Game endpoints 500: get_current_user only set user['_id']=str(...) but save/load used user['id'] -> KeyError. Fixed by setting user['id'] and removing _id. Frontend R3F errors caused by non-standard JSX attributes (x-line-number etc.) being forwarded to Three.js objects via applyProps.
